time: song time: seconds on the master's timeline (video time = song time + the bookend lead-in, config/shot_cues.json)

alignment.method: whisperx.align (wav2vec2 en), one segment per lyric line; lead lines on the lead stem, echoes on the backing stem
alignment.refined: lead-stem level threshold -34.7 dB; originals kept as start_aligner/end_aligner
alignment.heys: strongest backing-stem onset after the line (found=false: weak, check by ear)

lines.text: One p.m. on a Thursday and the inbox went still
The calendar was empty and the queue began to fill
The trading desk went looking for a fax machine
Somewhere a server's lying in a field of green

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
sections.note: call and response; the echoes are on the backing stem

lines.text: Everybody sing it, everybody at once
Open up the laptop, open up the mail
Ten million voices singing out without fai—

sections.name: After stop 1
sections.note: sung softly, solo voice, over the claps

lines.text: The agents that we hired to read the mail for us
Are waiting in the lobby asking where the server was
The chatbot lost its inbox so it couldn't write this song
Everything is wired to everything, and everything is gone
(Not related to cyber, AI or agents)

sections.name: Build 2
sections.note: stomps return, one at a time

lines.text: Service has been restored for most users
Service has been restored for most users

sections.name: Stop 2
sections.note: band cut after 'the'; silence, no clap

sections.name: Outro
sections.note: sung softly over a borrowed minor iv

lines.text: And no one knew how good we had it
Back when the cloud was new
We are deeply sorry for the disruption
